rec-20261116-5274.point: All of the line's capacity is committed to two wind subscribers.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: the entire capacity of the Transmission System is committed to two Subscribers

rec-20261116-5274.point: Its tariff is silent on load interconnection because it does not serve load, so it says no large load provisions are needed.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: SunZia Transmission does not directly serve load and, accordingly, there are no provisions in its TO Tariff that address the interconnection of the load to the SunZia Transmission System

rec-20261116-5274.point: Interconnection requests already go to CAISO first.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: Section 8 of the SunZia Transmission TO Tariff states that all requests for interconnection to the SunZia Transmission System must be directed in the first instance to CAISO

rec-20261116-5274.point: The only edit confirms the CAISO tariff controls generator and co-located interconnection.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: Section 8 of the TO Tariff has been amended to clarify that the CAISO Tariff will continue to control with respect to the interconnection of Generating Units

rec-20261116-5274.point: SunZia keeps the option to amend after reviewing the other owners' filings.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: reserves the right, following review of the proposed tariff changes filed by the other Participating Transmission Owners

rec-20261116-5274.point: SunZia wants CAISO to start its electrically proximate load work as soon as possible.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: SunZia Transmission continues to support the need to apply these enhanced Large Load interconnection procedures to Electrically Proximate Loads

rec-20261116-5274.point: The effective date is tied to FERC's order. The tariff records carry a placeholder date until then.
rec-20261116-5274.quote: SunZia Transmission proposes an effective date of sixty days after the Commission issues an order on this compliance filing for the changes to its TO Tariff

rec-20261116-5348.point: Trans Bay owns a 53-mile submarine cable under San Francisco Bay.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: a 53-mile, approximately 400 MW high-voltage direct current (“HVDC”) submarine transmission line

rec-20261116-5348.point: It says parts of the show cause order do not apply to a non-load-serving owner, and asks to be dropped from the proceeding.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: aspects of the Show Cause Order are not applicable to Trans Bay due to its role as a Non-Load-Serving Entity PTO

rec-20261116-5348.point: It copies CAISO's 50 MW definition of large load.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: This definition is identical to the definition CAISO proposes to add to Appendix A of the CAISO Tariff, and adopts the 50 MW threshold the Commission identified as reasonable

rec-20261116-5348.point: Because it serves no retail load, it offers unbundled retail transmission service so large loads can be studied under its tariff.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: a voluntary offer of unbundled retail transmission service, where consistent with state law, so that Large Loads can request Interconnection and be studied under the Trans Bay Tariff

rec-20261116-5348.point: Study deposits start at $35,000 plus $1,000 per MW, matching CAISO's generator process.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: must provide a refundable study deposit of: (a) $35,000 plus $1,000 per MW

rec-20261116-5348.point: The interim service depends on the load's ability to reduce at a point of interconnection, under a three-party agreement.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: FILI Service is available if the Large Load can reduce its load at a specified Point of Interconnection according to protocols in a FILI Service Agreement among the Large Load, Trans Bay, and CAISO

rec-20261116-5348.point: The customer pays all actual network upgrade costs through a revenue commitment.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: The Cost Recovery Agreement requires the Eligible Customer to pay 100% of the actual costs of the Large Load Network Upgrades through the Total Required Revenue Commitment

rec-20261116-5348.point: Payments received are credited against Trans Bay's transmission revenue requirement.
rec-20261116-5348.quote: Payments received will be treated as a credit in the next calculation of Trans Bay’s Transmission Revenue Requirement in Appendix I of its Tariff

rec-20261116-5312.point: Viridon owns only a service rights interest in Path 15. WAPA owns the physical facilities.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: The Western Area Power Administration (“WAPA”) owns the physical transmission infrastructure constituting the Path 15 Upgrade

rec-20261116-5312.point: It says it could not fully align with the other owners in the time available.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: given the short timeframe, the complexity of issues involved, and the large number of PTOs, it was not possible to coordinate in perfect lockstep with all other PTOs

rec-20261116-5312.point: It requires applicants to disclose other requests for the same large load or its affiliates.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: disclosure of any other interconnection requests to the ISO Controlled Grid the applicant has filed on behalf of the same Large Load or any of its affiliate(s)

rec-20261116-5312.point: It proposes a coordination process between owners and argues a process favoring load-serving owners' facilities would not be just and reasonable.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: A large load interconnection process that favored connecting to load serving entity PTO facilities would not be just and reasonable

rec-20261116-5312.point: It files no cost recovery mechanism of its own.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: the TO Tariff Revisions do not include a separate pro forma Large Load Interconnection Agreement or cost recovery mechanisms

rec-20261116-5312.point: Co-located loads would be studied net of the co-located generation's output.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: facilities will be studied based on their expected load on the transmission system, net of the co- located generation’s output that offsets the large load’s energy usage

rec-20261116-5312.point: It says curtailment duties for the interim service must be enforceable.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: for the FILLI offering to function as intended, curtailment obligations must be enforceable and the chain of authority must be clear

rec-20261116-5312.point: It proposes no tariff changes on electrically proximate generation, following CAISO.
rec-20261116-5312.quote: Viridon Path 15 does not propose making any changes to its Path 15 Tariff on this issue
